name: Starter Story

sources.title: Starter Story — Share Your Founder Story page

conditions: Free to be featured, but requires creating a Starter Story account (login/signup before submitting)
Editorial selection: Starter Story interviews founders — submission is an application, not an automatic listing
requirements: Must be a founder with a real business story to tell — this is an interview/case-study format, not a directory listing
Story should be 'real and raw' — how the business was started and grown
Site is owned by HubSpot Media; account signup accepts HubSpot's data-sharing terms
preparation: Founder story details: how you started, revenue numbers if shareable, growth tactics, lessons
A willingness to be interviewed (text/video) — testimonials on the page reference video interviews
Email for account creation (Google OAuth or passwordless email link also offered)
workflow: Create an account or log in (email, Google, or passwordless link)
Submit your founder/business information through the post-login flow
If selected, complete the interview process with the Starter Story team
Feature publishes as a case study/interview on starterstory.com (and potentially their YouTube/newsletter)
watchFor: Account wall: the actual submission form only appears after signup
Signup opts you into HubSpot/Starter Story marketing emails (disclosed on the form)
Selection is editorial — there is no guarantee or published timeline for being featured
This is not a dofollow-link directory; the SEO benefit comes only if they publish your story
countsAsLive: A published founder interview/case-study page on starterstory.com featuring the business
unknowns: What fields the post-login submission form asks for
Typical time from submission to feature
Whether outbound links in published stories are dofollow
